== Template:Item/Consumable ==

Template for displaying consumable item tooltips (potions, food, scrolls, etc.).

=== Parameters ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Required !! Description
|-
| '''image''' || Yes || Item icon image filename
|-
| '''name''' || Yes || Consumable name
|-
| '''value''' || No || Item value in gold, or "Unsellable"
|-
| '''description''' || No || Flavor text
|-
| '''disposable''' || No || Set to any value if item is consumed on use
|-
| '''effect_spell_name''' || No || If set, displays spell effect details
|-
| '''effect_*''' || No || Various effect parameters (see Item/SpellDetails)
|}

=== Consumable Types ===

* '''Disposable''' - Item is consumed when used (potions, food)
* '''Permanent''' - Effect is applied permanently (stat books, tokens)

=== Example ===

'''Code:'''
<pre>
{{Item/Consumable
|image=Breaded Island Fin.png
|name=Breaded Island Fin
|description=A rare fish that dwells near islands, now covered in bread crumbs and cooked
|disposable=1
|effect_spell_name=Nourished
|effect_spell_icon=Nourished.png
|effect_spell_level=1
|effect_spell_duration_ticks=166
|effect_spell_type=Beneficial
|effect_spell_line=Generic
|effect_hp=25
|effect_mana=25
|effect_movement_speed=1
}}
</pre>

'''Result:'''

{{Item/Consumable
|image=Breaded Island Fin.png
|name=Breaded Island Fin
|description=A rare fish that dwells near islands, now covered in bread crumbs and cooked
|disposable=1
|effect_spell_name=Nourished
|effect_spell_icon=Nourished.png
|effect_spell_level=1
|effect_spell_duration_ticks=166
|effect_spell_type=Beneficial
|effect_spell_line=Generic
|effect_hp=25
|effect_mana=25
|effect_movement_speed=1
}}

* [[Template:Item/SpellDetails]] - Effect information
* [[Template:Item/Categories]] - Auto-categorization
